svg.aria-label: The round island to scale: nine lands round Hearthmoot and its meadow
svg.text: The round island to scale: 10.9 km across, nine lands round Hearthmoot's meadow
White dots: three wake-up camps per land. Thin lines: each land's road in to a crossroads it shares.
Thick lines: four main roads across the meadow to the city's gates; squares: their forts at the meadow's edge.
Red triangles: major boss lairs, off the roads, deep inland. Dashed lines: coast (easy), midlands, inland (hard).
Yellow diamonds: Wind, Spore and Arcane starts. White dashes: sky islands. Purple and green dots: caves below.
Pale ring: calm shallows (300 m); wider ring: reefs (1.2 km); then deep sea. Blue line: the lake's stream.
